_note: What the gate requires at K=3. Raise these when the pipeline improves; lowering one to turn a red build green is how a gate stops meaning anything.
_min_precision: Absolute floor on mean precision@3 across the corpus. Set below the current 0.8333 so ordinary variance does not fail the build, and high enough that losing one of the six matched clips does.
_beat_baselines: The check that keeps working as the corpus grows. Absolute numbers move when assets are added; 'better than picking spans by the clock' does not. Only the two baselines that need no media are listed, because the gate has neither video files nor FFmpeg.
